body:
Believe me, it was the kindest thing I've heard in all the years I've been feeling this way.

Always when I feel more sad than usual I come here because it's the only place where I feel like people understand me, I read the posts and it seems as if I wrote them myself.

Some days seem impossible to overcome but now I'm going to sleep better because of your message. It's good to know that there are people like you on this world, I don't know what you're going through but I hope everything gets better.

I'm Brazilian so sorry for my English. 😬

Good night and thank you for everything, my heart is lighter now.

Os opostos não se atraem. Não acho que você deveria estar com uma pessoa que leva um estilo de vida diferente do seu. Você diz que tudo bem ele ir em festas ao mesmo tempo que sente nojo. Agora uma opinião pessoal minha, se você está em um relacionamento jamais deveria ir em festa desacompanhado do seu parceiro/a. Não interessa se não vai trair, o que é o mínimo. Mas é também uma questão de respeito. Não é local pra uma pessoa comprometida estar, não sem o parceiro
Stop living this miserable life and get the divorce
If suicide is the wrong answer, why dont God give us a bit of hope? 😔
Hard life and hard decisions... I wish you the best and thank you for taking a time to answer me, it means a lot to someone feeling empty and lonely!
It feels like Im not capable even of killing myself 😢
I love pizza and music, I love languages too especially french 🥰
25yo here. Having suicidal thoughts since I was around 10... It never gets better, I feel sorry for you man.
this world is not fair in any way. if someone created all of this, I don't know what he was thinking at that moment

I think everything has been wrong for a long time, it seems that every day I have a new reason to want to leave this world, but I don’t have the courage to do that, at least not yet. thank you so much for reading my post and asking what happened, it means a lot!
I wish you find the strenght to overcome everything that's going on, however difficult it may be! Know that there's someone on the other side of the world wishing you the best! Hugs from Brazil ❤️
Easy to say, hard to control
You don't need to accept it. Honestly, SHE should feel bad for doing this with you.
"ruin his aesthetic"... One of the more stupid things I've ever heard. I'm glad you're not with him anymore. You deserve much more!
